Product.title: Product
Product.description: Catalog product item managed by store admins and displayed to storefront visitors.

sizes.description: Available sizes for this product (bounded up to 15 items).

available.description: Whether the product is available (true) or out of stock (false).

image.description: Product image path, URL, or compressed image data URI.

features.description: Optional list of bullet features (bounded up to 10 items).

sortOrder.description: Numeric ordering priority for catalog display.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when product was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when product was last updated.

StoreMeta.title: StoreMeta
StoreMeta.description: Catalog initialization metadata controlled by administrators.

initialized.description: Whether the initial catalog has been seeded to Firestore.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of catalog metadata update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized store administrator registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

/products/{productId}.description: Publicly readable store catalog managed exclusively by verified admins.

/store_meta/{metaId}.description: Publicly readable store initialization metadata managed exclusively by verified admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Private admin RBAC registry readable/writable only by verified admins.
